paper_title: Cosmological bounds on pseudo Nambu-Goldstone bosons
notes: Paper establishes cosmological bounds on ALP two-photon coupling g (GeV^-1) vs mass m_phi (eV) from BBN, CMB, EBL, Neff, and dilution arguments. Coupling type is AxionPhoton (g_agamma in GeV^-1, Lagrangian L = -g/4 F~F phi). However, the exclusion limits are presented only as 2D region plots (Figs. 1, 2, 6) without tabulated numerical (mass, coupling) boundary values. No clean data points extractable. One analytic boundary relation given: g/GeV^-1 >~ 10^-3 (eV/m_phi)^(3/2) for the lower mass edge of the Neff bound. The plot spans roughly m_phi = 1 eV to 10^10 eV, g = 10^-18 to 10^-4 GeV^-1. Bounds are cosmological/early-universe, not a haloscope, so no local DM density applies. Confidence lowered due to absence of extractable numerical data points.
